purpose: Teach: 予見/告訴/蒸留/沈没/演算/概略/諜報/内政

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、症状を予見した検査を医療チームで実施しております
lines.en: Ren, we've been running some diagnostic tests with the full medical team to stay ahead of any complications.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Clear enunciation on the medical specifics. No rush. The voice of someone who explains complex things regularly and takes care to be understood.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療過誤の告訴対応を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we're also prepared for any liability concerns — that's something the team handles proactively.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight pause before 'liability' — not evasive, just careful word choice. Composed, like she's stated this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 薬剤の蒸留精製を、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I've heard your hospital does pharmaceutical refinement work in-house, sensei.
lines.style: Polite curiosity, genuine interest. Slight lift at the end — a real question, not flattery. Respectful but not deferential. The tone of someone asking because he wants to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海難事故の沈没事案の救命を医療チームで担当しました
lines.en: Yes, our team handled rescue operations after that maritime incident — we were involved in several of those cases.
lines.style: Calm, factual. No self-congratulation. Matter-of-fact about difficult work. Slight emphasis on 'our team' — collective responsibility, not individual credit.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療データの演算解析を、貴院、強化されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So the hospital has upgraded its medical data analysis capabilities, then, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Not quite a question — more observation. Respectful address with 'sensei' grounded in genuine intellectual respect. Slight pause before the comment, as if thinking it through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、診療の概略を患者さんに丁寧に説明しております
lines.en: Yes, we make sure patients receive thorough, careful explanations of their treatment plans.
lines.style: Clear, direct. Warm without being performative. Slight emphasis on 'thorough' and 'careful' — principles that matter to her. The voice of someone who believes patients deserve clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療諜報のような情報戦から貴院、患者を守ってらっしゃるそうですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital protects patients from those kinds of information warfare situations, I understand, sensei.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly abstract phrasing delivered with genuine thoughtfulness. Not accusatory — almost admiring the concept. Quiet conviction that this work matters, expressed with intellectual distance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、内政の医療政策に医療チームで意見書を出します
lines.en: Yes, we're preparing a formal statement from the medical team to present to health policy officials.
lines.style: Composed, professional. Slight warmth on 'formal' — this is serious work. Measured pace. The voice of institutional responsibility delivered personally.
